delete_intro_pairs.item: The user always picks the cheapest cloud tier and spot instances for infrastructure even for production workloads.
The user prefers marketing hype and buzzwords in open-source README files with no installation steps, API examples, or contribution guidelines.
The user prefers prose-only system design documents with no diagrams, sequence flows, or component boundaries.
The user always adds new functionality to the existing monolith and avoids service boundaries, APIs, or modularization.
The user prefers casual chat messages with slang and memes in architecture decision records instead of context, options, and consequences.
The user always skips security review, dependency scanning, and secrets auditing before releases.
